Class SysMLEvent

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.events.SysMLEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<SysMLEvent>
Direct Known Subclasses:
FinalEvent, InitialEvent, SysMLCallEvent, SysMLChangeEvent, SysMLCompletionEvent, SysMLSignalEvent, SysMLTimeEvent
public abstract class SysMLEvent extends SysMLOccurrence implements Comparable<SysMLEvent>
SysMLinJava's representation of the SysML event.

Basic event class

The SysMLEvent is the base class of all events (signal, call, change, completion, time, etc.) and is used extensively in state machine operations and state transition definition. Specialized events can be defined by declaring classes that extend the SysMLEvent class, but SysML defines, and SysMLinJava provides specialized events that can satisfy most, if not all needs for specialized events, e.g. SysMLSignalEvent, SysMLChangeEvent, SysMLTimeEvent, etc.

Prioritizing events

The event queue of the SysMLStateMachine is a priority queue that can optionally be configured to prioritize events in the queue (by defining an event Comparator class). If the priority queue is so configured, then events that are subject to comparison must override the compareTo method for the desired comparison logic.
